portfolioPolicy.objective: Minimize future maintenance cost by keeping only references that own a distinct, decision-relevant question.

tierDefinitions.core-reference: Review relevant source changes when the project-specific trigger fires; only this tier receives full source deep dives.
tierDefinitions.specialist-reference: Retain for exactly one narrow question; no broad repository review and only low-cadence metadata checks.
tierDefinitions.archive-reference: Preserve the 2026-07-28 evidence snapshot; no scheduled metadata or source refresh.
tierDefinitions.remove: No remaining distinct question; do not refresh and do not carry volatile metadata forward.

decisionRules: When two projects answer the same question, keep the stronger source and archive or remove the other.
Popularity, ecosystem size, generic agent breadth and already-absorbed basics are not retention reasons.
A counterexample can justify an archive snapshot, not an active refresh slot.
A new candidate must answer an uncovered planned question or displace an existing reference; it cannot only expand the list.
Stars, forks and routine release numbers are no longer maintained because they do not trigger product decisions.

coreValue.keepRule: Keep an active reference only when it is the strongest source for one distinct question tied to memo/context, intelligent planning, or Team workflow decisions.
coreValue.removeRule: Archive absorbed or overlapping evidence; remove entries with no distinct remaining question. Popularity and project breadth never override this rule.

core-reference.name: TencentDB-Agent-Memory
core-reference.uniqueReferenceQuestion: 上下文超预算时，如何把工具结果和记忆从 full 降级为 summary+ref / ref-only，同时保留可恢复原文与来源链？
core-reference.refreshTrigger: 其 auto-recall、offload 或 result-ref 机制发生相关源码变化；或 AIOS 修改 recall budget / validated compaction 合同时。普通版本号、star 变化不触发 deep dive。
core-reference.rationale: 12 项中对预算降级、分层 offload 与 ref provenance 的组合最直接，且 TypeScript 实现便于双侧源码核对；保留为唯一的预算/表示层核心参照。
core-reference.evidenceSnapshot: Recall 预算 (maxCharsPerMemory + maxTotalRecallChars), L0→L3 语义分层, Mermaid 符号化压缩思路, 独立 Memory 服务化路径

core-reference.name: oh-my-openagent
core-reference.uniqueReferenceQuestion: 恢复或继续 active work 时，如何绑定 session lineage、主动装配工作上下文，并在写入前识别 stale content？
core-reference.refreshTrigger: active-work discovery、continuation/lineage、Hashline stale-write guard 或相关配置 schema 发生源码变化；或 AIOS 进入 ExecutionContextPacket / write preflight 实施阶段。
core-reference.rationale: 它是当前组合中唯一同时覆盖主动恢复、lineage 与内容新鲜度写保护的实现；保留为规划到修改前工作集的核心参照，不再跟踪其泛化 agent 功能。
core-reference.evidenceSnapshot: active work 发现与主动恢复、session lineage/continuation、Hashline stale-write guard、per-agent skill filter

core-reference.name: OpenClaw
core-reference.uniqueReferenceQuestion: Agent 提出的 skill 或共享状态变更，如何通过 proposal → review → apply / rollback / quarantine，并用 provenance 与 stale hash 安全发布？
core-reference.refreshTrigger: skill workshop、install policy、proposal/review/apply/rollback/quarantine、provenance 或 stale-hash admission 发生相关源码变化；或 AIOS 准备开启 Team shared-canonical 写入。
core-reference.rationale: 其治理状态机和反向安全信号最完整，是 Team 发布门与可回滚治理的唯一核心参照；只审查治理路径，不扫描其渠道、桌面或通用插件面。
core-reference.evidenceSnapshot: Skill Workshop 治理闭环、Plugin 外部化、Operator install policy、Memory/channel SQLite

specialist-reference.name: Graphiti (Zep core)
specialist-reference.uniqueReferenceQuestion: 不复制图数据库时，事实的现实有效期、系统失效时间与原始 episode provenance 应如何共同建模？
specialist-reference.refreshTrigger: Graphiti 的 EntityEdge temporal/provenance contract 发生相关源码变化；或 AIOS 修改 ContextItem validity / supersede schema。除此之外不做仓库级刷新。
specialist-reference.rationale: 双时态与 episode provenance 仍是最强窄域证据，但图检索和数据库架构不属于版本目标；降为只回答 temporal semantics 的 specialist。
specialist-reference.evidenceSnapshot: 时序知识图谱 + 事实失效 (bi-temporal) + attribute-hallucination 防御；getzep/zep 主仓已 dormant 不再跟踪

specialist-reference.name: Letta Code
specialist-reference.uniqueReferenceQuestion: 如何只对模型实际读取过的记忆生成不可伪造、可回查的 citation / context receipt？
specialist-reference.refreshTrigger: memory-citations 从 prototype 升级、其实际读取观测链发生相关源码变化；或 AIOS 开始实现 ContextReceipt。其他 sleep-time / agent 功能不触发刷新。
specialist-reference.rationale: 实际读取驱动 citation 是独立且直接对应 ContextReceipt 的窄问题；实现仍是 prototype，不足以进入 core，也不值得全仓持续扫描。
specialist-reference.evidenceSnapshot: Sleep-Time 记忆整理、Task* CRUD、system prompt 版本化 canary；letta-ai/letta 主仓已 dormant 不再跟踪
